desc: The Buck Mark Contour Pro Red Dot is a practically perfect shooter. Not too big. Not too small. Perfect weight. Durable and reliable. This pistol looks spot on with a Crimson Trace Red Dot sight and co-witnessing Pro-Target adjustable rear sight and with a green fiber-optic front sight for excellent and speedy target acquisition. The pistol is threaded with 1/2"-28 suppressor ready threads and uses a compensator to reduce recoil and muzzle rise to improve accuracy and allow faster follow-up shots.
